planned_argument.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing. Create ONE finished flat opaque landscape 16:9 poster for an outdoor short-film screening and director conversation, shown on subway/community digital screens. Approachable adults, lively public culture. Full-bleed artwork only.

Visual system: energetic editorial montage of two large facing adult Korean neighbors, two-tone photographic cutouts in peach and deep aubergine, selective coarse halftone in photographic shadows, crisp independently owned contours, bold angular color fields and firm slightly condensed sans-serif typography. Saturated impact, close expressive human faces, controlled ink variation. No physical tape, mockup, contact sheet, 3D lettering or unrelated decoration.

Whole composition in an imaginary 1280×720 design grid (these describe proportions, not a requested pixel output): protect a central identity gap at roughly x390–875, y155–435. Listener profile and shoulder rise from lower-left, face turned up-right with engaged expression, cropped at left/bottom, roughly x0–350, y290–720. Speaker enters upper-right, roughly x900–1280, y0–460, warmly addressing listener, gaze down-left. One visible hand, naturally connected to speaker's own forearm, grips one complete handheld microphone near speaker's mouth. Keep hand/thumb/fingers and microphone silhouette intelligible and separate; no duplicated limbs, floating grip or disconnected forearm. The two facing crops and their diagonal exchange dominate the imagery. Faces, arms and crops stay outside the identity and both utility islands.

Central identity: peach title in two lines at an existing word boundary, first two words on first line and final word on second line, 74 design-px heavy Korean sans with sound Hangul proportions/counters and clear word gaps. Title fills the central exchange gap without touching faces. English immediately below, about30 design-px. Descriptor underneath in one horizontal line, about31 design-px, on solid aubergine. Print each of these entries exactly once:
다리 아래 영화관
BRIDGE CINEMA
야외 단편 상영 · 감독과의 대화

Schedule island upper-left, about390×225 at x32,y28, clean bright yellow-green angular plane. Horizontal aubergine text, wide open margins, date and time about40 design-px, venue about34. It remains clear of listener and title. Print each of these entries exactly once, in this order:
2026.12.05 토요일
18:00–20:30
홍제천 연가교 아래

Action island lower-right, about450×215 at x795,y475, peach angular plane with horizontal aubergine semibold text at32–34 design-px, generous line spacing. Full width available for admission/capacity; no compressed tiny words. Print each of these entries exactly once, in this order:
17:30부터 입장
무료 관람 · 선착순 80명
돗자리 지참
우천 시 실내로 변경

Cinema construction beneath central identity, separate from both utility islands: a substantial clearly rectangular illuminated portable projection screen around x445,y510, 280×145 design-px. Continuous dark rectangular frame, two clearly attached support legs to ground, readable even at720-pixel poster width. On its plane show projected flowing water/ripples, no text. A short bridge underside fragment spans above the screen, around y470, showing structural depth without becoming an identity frame. A small complete projector immediately left of the screen visibly sends a short unobstructed light cone from its lens toward the screen plane. Beam and projected water are bounded by the rectangular screen; preserve its corners, vertical edges and stands. This is visibly outdoor cinema beneath a bridge alongside a conversation, not a music-only event. The supported screen and light relation must survive reduction.

Typography must be precise and highly readable at actual720×405 viewing. Keep every supplied character, case, numeral, word boundary and punctuation in the ten entries. Preserve distinct paired colon dots, the time-range dash and separated middle dots with visible word gaps; no hyphen substitution, invented or repeated text. Only title may wrap at its existing word boundary; facts and descriptor horizontal, unobscured, with protected contrast. Reduce image/frame/title footprint before squeezing practical information. No added labels, numbers, logos, credits, watermarks, QR or pseudo-print. Texture belongs locally to photo cutouts and fields, never across small lettering. Finish cleanly with sharp type and owned edges.
